title: Poisson Integer Generator
text: Generate Poisson-distributed random integers, 1 output, {Poisson parameter(Lambda)} sets Poisson parameter λ; {Source of initial seed}, {Initial seed}, {Sample time}, {Samples per frame}, {Output data type} sets the data type of output and {Simulate using} sets the type of simulation to run. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Out
ports.summary: Random integer output scalar | vector | matrix

params.name: Poisson parameter(Lambda)
params.values: Poisson parameter λ 0.1 (default) | positive scalar | vector of positive scalars

params.name: Source of initial seed
params.values: Source of initial seed for random number generator Auto (default) | Parameter

params.name: Initial seed
params.values: Initial seed for random number generator nonnegative integer

params.name: Sample time
params.values: Sample time of output signal 1 (default) | -1 | positive scalar

params.name: Samples per frame
params.values: Samples per frame of output signal 1 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Output data type
params.values: Data type of output signal double (default) | uint8 | uint16 | uint32 | boolean

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: Type of simulation to run Code generation (default) | Interpreted execution
